featured_reviews.name: Soniii
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this restaurant with my friends about a week ago.
We tried the following items:
⭐ Nepali Paneer Chilly – 4/5
⭐ Cheese Pav Bhaji – 3/5
⭐ Veg Cheese Grilled Sandwich – 4/5
⭐ Masala Papad – 4/5
⭐ Mumbai Double Decker Sandwich – 5/5

Overall, the food was okay — some dishes were tasty, especially the Mumbai Double Decker Sandwich which we really loved.

The service was excellent, and the staff was polite and friendly, which made our visit pleasant.

But the most disappointing part was the Dry Fruit Faluda (₹220) — it was too costly and completely tasteless, felt just like plain milk. Definitely not worth the price.

Overall: Average food, excellent service, but very poor dessert quality.

featured_reviews.name: Ashna Bhagtani
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had an absolutely wonderful experience! The dosa was perfectly crisp on the outside and soft inside, served with delicious chutney and flavorful sambar. The pav bhaji was rich, buttery, and full of authentic taste – truly comforting and satisfying.

A very special shout-out to the restaurant team ❤️
We had requested them to prepare the food keeping in mind my elderly mother, who has food tantrums due to her age and is very particular about taste and texture. They were extremely kind and considerate with our request. The food was made just the way she likes it – light, balanced, and easy to eat.

Seeing her enjoy the meal with a big smile meant everything to us. Thank you for your care, patience, and amazing hospitality. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Shiv Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited my local 7-Eleven store and was thoroughly impressed with their selection of food snacks and beverages. The variety and quality surpassed my expectations, making it a convenient and satisfying stop for anyone on the go.

**Food Snacks:** The range of snacks available at 7-Eleven is outstanding. From classic chips and pretzels to healthier options like mixed nuts and granola bars, there’s something for every craving. I particularly enjoyed their freshly prepared sandwiches and wraps, which were not only delicious but also reasonably priced. The store also offers an assortment of pastries and baked goods that are perfect for a quick breakfast or a sweet treat.

**Hot Beverages:** The coffee at 7-Eleven is a standout feature. With multiple options for customization, including different roasts, flavored syrups, and various milk choices, it rivals many specialty coffee shops. Their hot chocolate and tea selections are also commendable, providing a warm, comforting option on colder days. The quality and freshness of their hot beverages make them a superb choice for any time of day.

**Cold Beverages:** The cold beverage section at 7-Eleven is equally impressive. They offer a wide array of soft drinks, juices, and energy drinks, as well as healthier choices like smoothies and bottled water. The Slurpee machine, a hallmark of 7-Eleven, provides a refreshing and fun treat, especially in the warmer months. The variety ensures that there’s always something new to try, catering to all taste preferences.

Overall, my experience with the food snacks and hot and cold beverages at 7-Eleven was excellent. The quality, variety, and convenience make it a top choice for anyone looking for a quick, delicious, and satisfying option. Whether you're grabbing a coffee on the way to work or picking up a snack during a road trip, 7-Eleven has you covered. Highly recommended!
